% RETURN, REBASED · EOD 2026-08-18
CYCLICALS LEADCyclicals +2.8% vs defensives on the month
Rotation ReadCitrini · claude

The rotation is pro-cyclical and narrowing into the metals and software, with energy and tech doing the heavy lifting while defensives get sold. XLE leads sectors at +7.56% one-month and +33.69% YTD, XLK holds +4.18% and +30.88%, and XLV quietly works at +4.36% with +8.31% YTD. XLU is the tell on the defensive side, down -4.11% over the month with a mere +1.53% YTD, and XLC is worse at -1.18% and -5.67% YTD. You own cyclicals and you sell utilities. The broad market is rotating toward real-economy sectors and away from yield-seeking defensives.

Theme baskets confirm the cyclical bid but the leadership is gold miners and software, semis and AI infra. Gold miners posted +22.2% in one month, quantum +18.1%, SaaS +15.1%, software +14.6%, and cyber +14.5%. AI infra sits at +98.2% YTD and semis at +76.5%, yet their one-month gains are +5.3% and +3.3% respectively. The leaders year-to-date are decelerating on the month while the laggards catch a violent bid. Mag 7 barely moves at +1.1% monthly and +3.6% YTD. You trim the YTD winners that are flat on the month and you add to the baskets with accelerating momentum. MDB leads software and SaaS while DDOG lags both, ZS leads cyber at +69.4% YTD, and AEM leads gold miners with KGC trailing. The signal underneath is breadth expanding beyond mega-cap tech into mid-cap software and commodity-related names.

The stretched ratios tell you this cyclical rotation is at an extreme. HYG/LQD carries a z-score of 2.83 and sits in the top 0% of its yearly range, JNK/TLT is at 2.56 also in the top 0%, and SPY/TLT is at 2.49 in the top 0% with a YTD move of +19.85%. TLT/SPY is the inverse at -2.27 and in the bottom 1% of its range, down -16.56% YTD. XLI/XLU is at 2.39 and in the top 2% of its range with a +15.89% YTD spread. These are confirmed trend extremes in a risk-on regime, and the trade is to stay with them until TLT/SPY stops making new lows. If SHY/TLT at 2.55 in the top 0% rolls over, the credit bid is cracking and you reduce cyclicals immediately.

Cyclicals and commodities lead at stretched extremes while mega-cap tech goes flat and defensives break down.

BULL

XLE at +33.69% YTD, industrials themes at +25.3%, and XLI/XLU at 2.39 sigma confirm a pro-cyclical regime with room to run as long as HYG/LQD holds its 2.83 z-score. The rotation into gold miners at +22.2% monthly and energy at +7.6% says real assets are leading and capital is committing to reflation.

BEAR

Every risk-on ratio sits in the top 0% of its yearly range and TLT/SPY is in the bottom 1%, which means the cyclical trade is consensus and crowded. XLC at -5.67% YTD and XLY at -0.39% show consumer-facing sectors failing, and Mag 7 at +3.6% YTD tells you the largest companies are not confirming the risk-on move underneath.

TELL

XLI/XLU at 2.39 sigma is the ratio to watch. If it breaks below its current level and XLU stops declining, the cyclical leadership is exhausted and you shift to defensives.

⚠ Cyber at **+69.4%** YTD and **+14.5%** monthly says software and security names are accelerating and broadening the rally beyond mega-cap. vs Mag 7 at **+3.6%** YTD and **+1.1%** monthly with XLC at **-5.67%** YTD says the largest indices are not confirming the breadth thrust.: Trust the broadening read. When YTD leaders like semis at **+76.5%** slow to **+3.3%** monthly while cyber and SaaS surge, capital is rotating to laggards and the narrow leadership is breaking. The Mag 7 flatline is a lagging signal, not a leading one.
⚠ XLI/XLU at **2.39** sigma and XLE at **+33.69%** YTD confirm a durable pro-cyclical rotation. vs Every risk-on ratio in the top **0%** of its yearly range with HYG/LQD at **2.83** sigma says the cyclical trade is at maximum extension.: Trust the trend but respect the extreme. You keep cyclicals on but you stop adding at these z-scores. The tell is HYG/LQD. If it rolls from **2.83**, credit is leading equities lower and you cut exposure.

The credit and cross-asset ratios are the most extreme and they are confirmed trend, mean-reversion candidates. HYG/LQD at 2.83 sigma and JNK/TLT at 2.56 both sit in the top 0% of their yearly ranges, and they accompany SPY/TLT at 2.49 in the top 0% with a +19.85% YTD move.

These are not reversion setups. They are the signature of a sustained risk-on regime where high yield outpaces investment grade and equities crush duration.

TLT/IEF at -2.50 sigma and in the bottom 0% confirms the long-end is the weakest link, down -2.49% YTD on the ratio. XLI/XLU at 2.39 sigma in the top 2% with a +15.89% YTD spread is the same trade expressed through sectors.

The one ratio that looks like a genuine mean-reversion candidate is XLC/SPY at -2.20 sigma and in the bottom 0% of its range, down -16.58% YTD. Communication services is so washed out relative to the market that any stabilization in XLC at current levels gives you an asymmetric counter-trend entry.

XLU/SPY at -2.13 sigma in the bottom 2% is different. Utilities deserve to be weak here because XLU is down -4.11% on the month and the cyclical bid is real.

You do not touch XLU until HYG/LQD breaks below 2.83.
